attr.title: Hostile Lands
attr.desc: A skill-based bullet-hell shooter with a TON of colorful characters, crunchy gunplay, and a planet that holds a grudge. Rescue your crew, reach the escape pod, and get out. The catch: every escape cranks up the Hostility toward those left behind.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and to get correct full version files use the following command in Steam Console: download_depot 3075890 3075891 579778157361625400. Copy downloaded files into assets folder. You can also use the free demo version. H700 devices are a minimum and stronger devices like Mangmi Air X are recommended.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3075890/Hostile_Lands/) and to get correct full version files use the following command in  [Steam Console](steam://open/console): `download_depot 3075890 3075891 579778157361625400`. Copy downloaded files into `assets` folder.  You can also use the free demo version. `H700` devices are a minimum and stronger devices like `Mangmi Air X` are recommended.
